projects.title: LEDGER: Self-Verifying RAG
projects.description: Question answering over U.S. federal budget and energy reports that splits each answer into atomic claims, checks every claim against retrieved source evidence with a local 7–8B model, and rewrites or removes unsupported statements. A fix for a Docling table-parsing defect, rebuilding tables from the PDF text layer, raised held-out table-cell accuracy from 30.5% to 100%. Traced with OpenTelemetry and Arize Phoenix on AWS EC2, with automated tests in GitHub Actions CI.

projects.title: TheraMind: Dual-Mode Clinical LLM Agent
projects.description: Clinical LLM agent fine-tuned from Llama 3.2-3B with QLoRA and DPO on 9,250 clinical dialogues, improving ROUGE-L from 0.40 to 0.78 in a 19.5-minute training run on an RTX 4090. One model runs a patient-intake chat, then writes a structured SOAP note for the doctor, grounded by ChromaDB RAG, constrained decoding and emergency-symptom overrides. Served with FastAPI in Docker on Hugging Face Spaces.

projects.title: BreachLens: Breach Notification Pipeline
projects.description: Python and KNIME pipeline that extracts PII/PHI from synthetic breach documents (PDFs, scanned forms and messy Excel/CSV exports), validates it with about 60 reason codes, verifies addresses with the U.S. Census geocoder, and matches people across files into one privacy-safe notification list per state. Matched the ground truth exactly (155/155) and processes 50,000 rows in about 39 seconds; raw identifiers never reach an output file.
